vaal: Atziri, Atziri, ek te mucane Vaal!
gold_en: Atziri, Atziri, star of the mighty Vaal!

vaal: Ti itsok anab nochira! Kextal xi kujkuali ik'bala!
gold_en: To you, the blood of all your servants; transform us, make our spirit worthy!
Atziri, Atziri, undying breath of the Vaal!

vaal: A'te 'Ibil tlayeb kutsen! A'te ik'el tlayeb kifba!
gold_en: Here, our flesh laid bare in the dark, the offering; here, our hidden self in the dark, the heart!
Atziri, Atziri, risen into the eternal waters!

vaal: Aiokmo til xu'te! Aiokmo tul jare elba!
gold_en: No more burning to ash, no ending; no more dwindling to embers, no going out!
Pour it out, all that we are!

vaal: 'Ayok ta' en, u mujuk' le mucane, niáach i'chian.
gold_en: Nothing more for me now; the strength of the mighty is in me, deep within her house.
Behold the offering; there stands another!
The heart beats no more; for Atziri, the undying, the white drink.
You are the breath within it, the sacred water, our draught.

vaal: Xi u'te cha'tsoke, a'te itsok xefe yotlapek le le Vaal te'moxti qexcan...
gold_en: See, the end comes round again; behold the blood. Commander of the Vaal altar, where all are remade…

vaal: Ich tlapec u'te puyao, a'te itsok pu uch' ta'nuk!
gold_en: On the altar, watch it redden; behold the blood; drink deep, great one!

vaal: A'te Kuxkal tlayeb kutsen. Ela tlayeb ukto! Máax ka ti a'tul?
gold_en: Behold the living, the offering in the dark. The dark torch burns! Who goes there?
Who are you to stand watch here?
Who is the mighty of the dark?
Into the dark you come; and so, your waning!
